import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

report_path = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
artifact_root = report_path.parent
report = json.loads(report_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert report['status'] == 'PASS'
assert report['candidate'] == {'commit': sys.argv[2], 'tree': sys.argv[3]}
assert report['postgresql']['status'] == 'PASS'
assert report['postgresql']['major'] == 18
assert report['browser']['status'] == 'PASS'
assert report['browser']['keyboard_and_action_reachability'] == {
    'attention_row_selection': 'Space',
    'open_episode': 'Enter',
    'family_center_assets_outcomes_operations_navigation': 'Enter',
}
assert report['negative_controls_status'] == 'PASS'
expected_paths = {'attention_to_episode', 'family_center', 'assets', 'outcomes', 'operations'}
assert set(report['exercised_product_paths']) == expected_paths
assert all(path.get('status') == 'PASS' for path in report['exercised_product_paths'].values())
assert set(report['failure_inventory']) == {'console_errors', 'page_errors', 'failed_requests', 'http_errors'}
assert all(not values for values in report['failure_inventory'].values())
expected_screenshots = {f'{name}-1440x900.png' for name in ('attention', 'episode', 'family-center', 'assets', 'outcomes', 'operations')}
screenshots = report['browser']['screenshots']
assert len(screenshots) == 6
assert {item['path'] for item in screenshots} == expected_screenshots
artifact_records = {item['path']: item for item in report['artifacts']}
expected_artifacts = expected_screenshots | {'failure-inventory.json'}
assert set(artifact_records) == expected_artifacts
for item in screenshots:
    assert item['kind'] == 'browser_screenshot'
    content = (artifact_root / item['path']).read_bytes()
    assert len(content) == item['byte_size']
    assert hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() == item['sha256']
    assert artifact_records[item['path']]['sha256'] == item['sha256']
failure_bytes = (artifact_root / 'failure-inventory.json').read_bytes()
assert json.loads(failure_bytes) == report['failure_inventory']
assert len(failure_bytes) == artifact_records['failure-inventory.json']['byte_size']
assert hashlib.sha256(failure_bytes).hexdigest() == artifact_records['failure-inventory.json']['sha256']
assert [gate['gate'] for gate in report['gates']] == [f'G{i:02d}' for i in range(13)]
gate_states = {gate['gate']: gate['state'] for gate in report['gates']}
assert {gate: gate_states[gate] for gate in ('G02', 'G06', 'G10', 'G11', 'G12')} == {'G02': 'NOT_RUN', 'G06': 'NOT_RUN', 'G10': 'NOT_RUN', 'G11': 'NOT_RUN', 'G12': 'PENDING'}
def all_keys(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key, child in value.items():
            yield key
            yield from all_keys(child)
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for child in value:
            yield from all_keys(child)
assert not any(any(term in key.lower() for term in ('production_ready', 'readiness')) for key in all_keys(report))
nonclaims = set(report['explicit_nonclaims'])
assert {
    'Synthetic data does not satisfy real-family G02 or G06.',
    'The empty/synthetic Outcomes route does not satisfy real independently audited G11.',
    'Local synthetic PostgreSQL/browser evidence does not satisfy production-like G10.',
    'G12, Port Gate, release promotion, company deployment readiness, and Production are not run or claimed.',
    'No company adapter, identity binding, private source row, mapping, endpoint, credential, or TLS configuration is present.',
} <= nonclaims
print('QUALIFICATION_REPORT_AND_ARTIFACT_ASSERTIONS_PASS')
